notes: Cloth consumption ab sirf METRES mein — FG CLOTH phase, desktop editor, History aur print sab mein metres; stock ke peeche kg se kat-ti hai (metres ÷ quality). Quality set na ho to us item ki cloth entry block hoti hai, andaza kabhi nahi. Mobile Post par ab completeness gate hai: plan ki har item ke charon phases (TOP, FOAM, ADHESIVE, CLOTH) mein consumption ho to hi Post hoga, warna popup mein plan → item → phase ke saath kami ki list milegi; Draft save par gate nahi. Save-parity lock: complete + saved consumption ke baad plan dono taraf (desktop aur mobile) se band — Record Consumption ka button desktop se bhi gayab, correction sirf History Edit se.
releaseNotes: Cloth metres + Post gate + save-parity pack: C1 cloth consumption in METRES everywhere (FG CLOTH phase, desktop editor, both Histories, print — print unit forced to m); underneath, stock deducts in kg as metres ÷ clothQuality; quality unset blocks cloth entry (never estimated); legacy kg records convert on display (27.27 kg = 299.97 m at quality 11) and on first edit. C2 mobile Post completeness gate: Post finalizes only when every plan item has consumption > 0 in all four phases TOP/FOAM/ADHESIVE/CLOTH; otherwise a professional English popup lists exactly plan → item → phase missing; Save as Draft is not gated. C3 save-parity lock: a complete + saved consumption finalizes the plan in the same save flow (desktop) and removes it from the mobile plan dropdown; the desktop Record Consumption button is hidden for finalized plans; History Edit remains the only correction path. C3 desktop finding: the desktop button was previously unconditional — the lock is newly implemented, not pre-existing behaviour. Verification: 45 new node harness checks + 8 new real-Chromium probe checks green; all legacy harnesses and probes green (expectation changes, all caused by this pack: consumption-finalize, fg-weakpoints, fg-footer-clothphase harnesses + probes rewritten for metres/gate; dept-select D6 UC half not re-run — its bespoke smoke dist builder was lost with the /tmp wipe and the surface is untouched by this pack). One flaw found and fixed during harnessing: the print builder converted the cloth quantity to metres but its unit fell back to Kg — now forced to m for the Backing Cloth phase. Zero live-data writes.
